approach-emergency-record-per-release.reason: An emergency record binds one exact change and terminates when that change merges or is abandoned, so a permanent file rewritten on every release would need a fresh owner-governance commit and a mandatory follow-up issue each time. That converts a bounded exception into routine process and drains its distinct warning of meaning, while leaving the other seven paths latent.

approach-catch-all-pattern.reason: A catch-all makes the unclassified state unreachable, converting a fail-closed default into a fail-open one: a genuinely novel path would silently inherit a default class instead of demanding a decision. The completeness control achieves the same coverage guarantee while preserving the failure.
